s01.title: Welcome to AbElements
s01.body: A free, open-source Next.js UI library: eight focused packages that share one theme, with live docs and examples for every element.
s01.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the eight AbElements packages all connect to the AbElements logo.

packages.components: Buttons, tabs, menus & a splash screen

s02.title: Core elements
s02.body: The config, layouts and accessible primitives every other AbElements package builds on.
s02.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the AbProvider hub wired to config, Slot, client/server, focus ring, Portal and locale nodes.

s03.title: Ready-made components
s03.body: Accessible React UI built on Core and Theme, from buttons and tabs to menus and a splash screen.
s03.illustrationAlt: Diagram: ab-nextjs-components wired to Button, Switch, Tabs, Sheet, Avatar and BottomNav previews.

s04.title: Warm, tokenised theming
s04.body: Bronze design tokens as CSS variables, with a real dark mode and no flash on load.
s04.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the ThemeProvider palette wired to tokens, colour scheme, light and dark, radius, contrast and Tailwind nodes.

s05.title: Tree-shakable icons
s05.body: SVG icons with typed names. Import only the icons you ship.
s05.illustrationAlt: Diagram: an icon set wired to size, variant, Icon, bundle, fill axis and typed import nodes.

s06.title: Fonts without layout shift
s06.body: Inter, Zilla Slab, Mulish, Quicksand and Roboto, self-hosted for Next.js with simple font-* utilities.
s06.illustrationAlt: Diagram: ab-nextjs-fonts wired to Zilla Slab, Inter weights, Inter, Mulish, Quicksand and Roboto samples.

s07.title: Animations that feel right
s07.body: Easings, fades and transitions that respect the reduced-motion setting out of the box.
s07.illustrationAlt: Diagram: an ease-out curve with a moving dot, wired to spring, duration, preset, reduced motion, Animate and stagger nodes.

s08.title: Typed React hooks
s08.body: Small, typed hooks for the theme, media queries, storage and the clipboard.
s08.illustrationAlt: Diagram: ab-nextjs-hooks wired to useTheme, useMedia, useHotkey, useLocalStorage, useMounted and useClipboard.

s09.title: Every language, built in
s09.body: Translated messages, locale routes and hreflang alternates for Next.js, ready for every AbElements app.
s09.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the AbI18nProvider hub, with a globe and a greeting cycling through English, French, Spanish and Russian, wired to messages/en.json, AbLocaleSwitcher, useAbTranslations, AbLocalePrefix, Intl number formatting and getAbAlternates hreflang nodes.

s10.title:
Build your web apps

for free with AbElements
s10.body: Eight open-source packages, live docs and one PWA. MIT, free forever.
s10.illustrationAlt: Diagram: the eight packages, the docs and the PWA all connect to AbElements.
